name: Web Access Logs: Probes and Exposure
name_zh: 網頁存取記錄：探測與外洩
summary: Adds what Wazuh's built-in web rules leave out: requests for sensitive files and exploit endpoints, whether one was answered with real content, vulnerability scanners, and quiet internal monitoring; plus an agent group that reads every web log, not only access.log. Optional active responses block an attacking address in nginx or at Cloudflare.
summary_zh: 補上 Wazuh 內建網頁規則沒有的部分：敏感檔案與漏洞端點的探測、是否真的回應了內容、弱點掃描工具，並讓內部監控不再吵；另附一個讀取所有網頁記錄（而不只是 access.log）的 agent 群組。選用的主動回應可以在 nginx 或 Cloudflare 封鎖攻擊來源位址。
author: Jason Tools
notes: The attack signatures stay Wazuh's own: SQL injection, XSS, traversal, long URLs, Shellshock and floods of 4xx/5xx are rules 31100-31170 and 31500-31540, maintained with the ruleset. This pack adds what they leave out and needs the combined log format, which those rules read.

Sensitive files: .env, .git, .svn, .hg, cloud and package-registry credentials, SSH and TLS private keys, database dumps and site archives, /proc/self/environ. A failed request (4xx) is level 6; six of them from one source in five minutes is level 10.

A request answered 2xx is level 10, and level 12 when the server logs the response content type as the last quoted field and it is not HTML. An HTML answer is an SPA or CMS fallback page serving every path, so it drops to level 3. Without the content type the 2xx answer stays at level 10: check it.

Known exploit endpoints and web shells (phpunit eval-stdin, Spring actuator, Symfony profiler, Vite source access, router and appliance paths, well-known web shell names): failed requests level 6, six from one source level 10, an answer with content level 12.
Vulnerability scanner user agents (sqlmap, nuclei, nikto, wpscan and others) are level 6, and 20 requests from one scanner in five minutes level 10.

Internal monitoring is quiet: server-status and similar pages polled from loopback or private addresses, and monitoring checks (certificate, HTTP, uptime) that get a 4xx from a private address, go to level 2. These were the largest share of web alerts on a live manager: about 380 a day from one host's server-status polling alone.
Paths inside WebDAV (/remote.php/ and /public.php/webdav, Nextcloud and ownCloud) are never treated as probes: sync clients upload .git folders, .env files and keys that live in users' directories.

Active responses (1.1, opt-in: installing or updating the pack blocks nothing). A firewall cannot block a visitor who comes through Cloudflare or another proxy, because the connection it sees is the proxy's, so these responses block where the client address is known: in nginx (jt-nginx-deny, a deny list included at http level and matched against the address realip restored) or at Cloudflare (jt-cloudflare-block, an IP Access Rule made through the API from the manager). They are offered for the high-confidence rules only: a sensitive file or exploit endpoint answered with content (133012, 133022), six probes from one source in five minutes (133040, 133041) and a scanner flood (133042). Both refuse private, loopback, carrier NAT, documentation and Cloudflare addresses and anything in their allowlist; a block ends with the timeout (a day by default), and jt-nginx-deny also drops entries older than a week, for when an agent restart makes execd forget its timer. 133050 (level 10) reports a block or unblock that failed, 133051 (level 7) an alert whose source was a Cloudflare address, which means that site does not restore the client address.

The agent group web reads every access and error log under /var/log/apache2, /var/log/httpd and /var/log/nginx. The default agent configuration reads only access.log and error.log, so sites with their own log files were never analysed. A file also listed elsewhere is read once. JSON access logs in the same directories are read too and decoded by the built-in json decoder; this pack's rules apply to the combined format only.
notes_zh: 攻擊特徵仍然用 Wazuh 自己的規則：SQL injection、XSS、目錄穿越、過長網址、Shellshock 與大量 4xx/5xx 是 31100-31170 與 31500-31540，隨規則集維護。本套件補上它們沒有的部分，需要那些規則讀得懂的 combined 記錄格式。
敏感檔案：.env、.git、.svn、.hg、雲端與套件庫的憑證、SSH 與 TLS 私鑰、資料庫傾印與網站封存檔、/proc/self/environ。請求失敗（4xx）是 level 6；同一來源五分鐘內六次是 level 10。
回應 2xx 是 level 10；伺服器把回應的內容類型記在最後一個引號欄位、而且不是 HTML 時是 level 12。HTML 的回應是單頁應用或 CMS 對所有路徑都回首頁，降到 level 3。沒有記內容類型時 2xx 維持 level 10，需要人工確認。
已知的漏洞端點與 web shell（phpunit eval-stdin、Spring actuator、Symfony profiler、Vite 原始碼存取、路由器與設備的路徑、常見 web shell 檔名）：請求失敗 level 6，同一來源六次 level 10，回應了內容 level 12。
弱點掃描工具的 User-Agent（sqlmap、nuclei、nikto、wpscan 等）是 level 6，同一個掃描器五分鐘內 20 次是 level 10。
內部監控不吵：從本機或私有位址輪詢 server-status 這類頁面、以及監控檢查（憑證、HTTP、運作時間）從私有位址得到 4xx，都是 level 2。在一台正式 manager 上這是網頁告警的最大宗：光一台主機的 server-status 輪詢每天約 380 筆。
WebDAV 底下的路徑（/remote.php/ 與 /public.php/webdav，Nextcloud 與 ownCloud）一律不當成探測：同步程式會上傳使用者目錄裡的 .git 資料夾、.env 與金鑰。

主動回應（1.1，需自行開啟：安裝或更新套件不會封鎖任何東西）。經 Cloudflare 或其他代理連進來的訪客，防火牆封鎖不了，因為它看到的是代理的連線；所以這些回應在知道用戶端位址的地方封鎖：在 nginx（jt-nginx-deny，在 http 層引入的封鎖清單，比對 realip 還原後的位址），或在 Cloudflare（jt-cloudflare-block，由 manager 透過 API 建立 IP Access Rule）。只提供給高可信度的規則：敏感檔案或漏洞端點回應了內容（133012、133022）、同一來源五分鐘內六次探測（133040、133041）與大量掃描（133042）。兩者都拒絕封鎖私有、迴環、電信業者 NAT、文件用途與 Cloudflare 的位址，以及允許清單裡的位址；封鎖在逾時（預設一天）後解除，jt-nginx-deny 另外會移除超過一週的項目，以防 agent 重啟讓 execd 忘了計時。133050（level 10）回報封鎖或解除失敗，133051（level 7）回報告警來源是 Cloudflare 的位址，代表那個網站沒有還原用戶端位址。

agent 群組 web 讀取 /var/log/apache2、/var/log/httpd、/var/log/nginx 底下所有存取與錯誤記錄。agent 預設只讀 access.log 與 error.log，所以有自己記錄檔的網站從來沒被分析過。同一個檔案在別處也有列出時只讀一次。同目錄下的 JSON 存取記錄也會被讀取並由內建 json 解碼器解析；本套件的規則只適用 combined 格式。

agent_group.name: web
agent_group.description: Every access and error log under /var/log/apache2, /var/log/httpd and /var/log/nginx; also carries the optional nginx active response (jt-nginx-deny) and its nginx snippet, inert until installed by hand

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers. The pack is one rule file on the built-in web access rules and needs no list.
setup.body_zh: 從本頁安裝，再到規則分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集會同步規則檔，但不會重新載入 worker。本套件是掛在內建網頁存取規則下的一個規則檔，不需要清單。

setup.title: Add every web server to the web group
setup.title_zh: 把每台網頁伺服器加入 web 群組
setup.body: Assign agents that run Apache or nginx to the group web and restart them (agent_control -R -u <id>). The group reads every access and error log in the usual directories, not only access.log.
setup.body_zh: 把執行 Apache 或 nginx 的 agent 加入 web 群組並重啟（agent_control -R -u <id>）。這個群組會讀取常見目錄下所有存取與錯誤記錄，而不只是 access.log。

setup.title: nginx: log the combined format with the content type
setup.title_zh: nginx：以 combined 格式記錄並附上內容類型

setup.title: Apache: keep the combined format, with the content type if you can
setup.title_zh: Apache：維持 combined 格式，可以的話附上內容類型
setup.body: Use the standard combined format so the client address comes first: LogFormat "%h %l %u %t \"%r\" %>s %b \"%{Referer}i\" \"%{User-Agent}i\" \"%{Content-Type}o\"" jt_combined. A format that puts the virtual host name second (vhost_combined, or %a %v ...) is decoded by Wazuh with the host name as the source address.
setup.body_zh: 使用標準 combined 格式，讓用戶端位址在最前面：LogFormat "%h %l %u %t \"%r\" %>s %b \"%{Referer}i\" \"%{User-Agent}i\" \"%{Content-Type}o\"" jt_combined。把虛擬主機名稱放在第二欄的格式（vhost_combined，或 %a %v ...），Wazuh 會把主機名稱當成來源位址。

setup.title: Active responses: define the commands on every manager node
setup.title_zh: 主動回應：在每個 manager 節點定義指令
setup.body: Only needed for the active responses below, and only the command of the responses you will use. Paste the block into ossec.conf on every manager node, inside <ossec_config>, and restart the manager there: an active response, and a command it uses, take effect only after a restart (the manager also sends its agents the new command list then). timeout_allowed must be yes: the block is removed by the delete Wazuh sends at the end of the timeout. Addresses in the manager's <global><white_list> are never sent to a response. Nothing is blocked until a response is switched on in this pack.
setup.body_zh: 只有下方的主動回應需要，而且只需要你會用到的那個指令。把區塊貼進每個 manager 節點 ossec.conf 的 <ossec_config> 內，然後在那個節點重新啟動 manager：主動回應與它使用的指令要重新啟動後才生效（manager 也會在那時把新的指令清單送給 agent）。timeout_allowed 必須是 yes：封鎖是由 Wazuh 在逾時結束時送出的 delete 解除。manager 的 <global><white_list> 裡的位址永遠不會送給回應。在本套件中開啟回應之前，不會封鎖任何東西。
setup.verify: On every node: grep -A3 '<name>jt-nginx-deny</name>' /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf, and /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t prints no error.
setup.verify_zh: 在每個節點：grep -A3 '<name>jt-nginx-deny</name>' /var/ossec/etc/ossec.conf，且 /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t 沒有錯誤。

setup.title: Active responses: install the nginx deny list on each reverse proxy
setup.title_zh: 主動回應：在每台反向代理安裝 nginx 封鎖清單
setup.body: On each nginx host that should block (usually the reverse proxy), as root. The web group delivers the script and the snippet to /var/ossec/etc/shared/, where they do nothing. Copy the script into active-response/bin rather than linking it: the shared folder changes whenever the group's files change, and a program that runs as root must not; after a pack update, compare and copy again. The snippet goes in a file nginx reads inside the http block and before the server blocks (conf.d/000-... on a stock nginx.org install, or the first file of the directory nginx.conf includes for the sites): it includes the deny list at http level, which every server and location inherits unless it has allow or deny lines of its own. Find those with grep -rnE '^\s*(allow|deny)\s' /etc/nginx and add include /etc/nginx/jt-ar-deny.rules; before their own lines, or put if ($jt_ar_denied) { return 403; } in that server, which covers all its locations. A location that answers with return (a redirect) answers before access checks; proxied and static content is blocked. Check that set_real_ip_from lists only Cloudflare's and your own proxies' ranges, never 0.0.0.0/0. Put administrator, monitoring and partner addresses in /etc/nginx/jt-ar-allow.txt, one address or network per line; a line that does not parse stops every block until fixed. Each block reloads nginx, so set worker_shutdown_timeout (for example 30s) if the sites keep WebSocket or other long connections, or old workers pile up. Optional: an hourly --expire from cron removes entries older than a week if an agent restart made execd forget a timer. Settings (paths, ipv6_prefix 64 to block a /64, reload through systemctl) go in /var/ossec/etc/jt-nginx-deny.conf.
setup.body_zh: 以 root 在每台要封鎖的 nginx 主機上執行（通常是反向代理）。web 群組會把腳本與設定片段送到 /var/ossec/etc/shared/，放在那裡不會有任何作用。請把腳本複製到 active-response/bin，不要用連結：群組檔案每次變動 shared 資料夾都會跟著變，而以 root 執行的程式不應如此；套件更新後請比對再複製一次。設定片段放在 nginx 於 http 區塊內、早於 server 區塊讀到的檔案（nginx.org 標準安裝是 conf.d/000-...，或 nginx.conf 為網站引入的目錄中第一個檔案）：它在 http 層引入封鎖清單，每個 server 與 location 都會繼承，除非它自己有 allow 或 deny。用 grep -rnE '^\s*(allow|deny)\s' /etc/nginx 找出這些區塊，在它們自己的那幾行之前加上 include /etc/nginx/jt-ar-deny.rules;，或在該 server 加 if ($jt_ar_denied) { return 403; }，可涵蓋其所有 location。以 return 回應的 location（轉址）會在存取檢查前就回應；代理與靜態內容都會被擋。確認 set_real_ip_from 只列 Cloudflare 與自家代理的範圍，絕不能是 0.0.0.0/0。把管理者、監控與合作夥伴的位址寫進 /etc/nginx/jt-ar-allow.txt，每行一個位址或網段；有一行無法解析時，修好之前所有封鎖都會停止。每次封鎖都會重新載入 nginx，網站有 WebSocket 或其他長連線時請設定 worker_shutdown_timeout（例如 30s），否則舊的 worker 會越積越多。選用：由 cron 每小時執行一次 --expire，在 agent 重啟讓 execd 忘了計時時移除超過一週的項目。設定（路徑、ipv6_prefix 設 64 以封鎖整個 /64、改用 systemctl 重新載入）寫在 /var/ossec/etc/jt-nginx-deny.conf。
setup.code:
install -o root -g wazuh -m 0750 /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-nginx-deny /var/ossec/active-response/bin/jt-nginx-deny
touch /etc/nginx/jt-ar-deny.map /etc/nginx/jt-ar-deny.rules /etc/nginx/jt-ar-allow.txt
install -m 0644 /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-ar-deny-nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/000-jt-ar-deny.conf
nginx -t && nginx -s reload
/var/ossec/active-response/bin/jt-nginx-deny --check
echo '17 * * * * root /var/ossec/active-response/bin/jt-nginx-deny --expire >/dev/null' > /etc/cron.d/jt-nginx-deny
setup.verify: --check prints settings ok and nginx -t ok. After a response blocks, jt-nginx-deny --list shows the address and the manager shows rule 657 (Active response: active-response/bin/jt-nginx-deny - add); a failure is rule 133050. jt-nginx-deny --unblock <address> lifts a block by hand.
setup.verify_zh: --check 會顯示 settings ok 與 nginx -t ok。回應封鎖之後，jt-nginx-deny --list 會列出該位址，manager 上出現規則 657（Active response: active-response/bin/jt-nginx-deny - add）；失敗是規則 133050。jt-nginx-deny --unblock <位址> 可以手動解除封鎖。

setup.title: Active responses: block at Cloudflare (sites proxied by Cloudflare)
setup.title_zh: 主動回應：在 Cloudflare 封鎖（經 Cloudflare 代理的網站）
setup.body: On every manager node, as root: the response runs on the node that raised the alert, so a worker needs the same files (copy them from the master). Create an API token in the Cloudflare dashboard with the permission Account > Account Firewall Access Rules > Edit for account scope, or Zone > Firewall Services > Edit for the zones listed (zone scope), and nothing else; put it alone in /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare.token, owned by root, mode 600: the script refuses a file others can read and never writes the token anywhere. account_id (or zone_ids) is on the dashboard's overview page. The managers need outbound HTTPS to api.cloudflare.com (set proxy= in the settings file if they go through one), and the script runs with /usr/bin/python3: the Python bundled with Wazuh has no CA certificates. Put administrator, monitoring and partner addresses in /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare-allow.txt. mode can be managed_challenge instead of block for a softer response.
setup.body_zh: 以 root 在每個 manager 節點執行：回應在產生告警的節點上執行，所以 worker 也需要同樣的檔案（從 master 複製）。在 Cloudflare 控制台建立 API token，帳戶範圍給 Account > Account Firewall Access Rules > Edit 權限，zone 範圍則給列出的 zone 的 Zone > Firewall Services > Edit，其他一律不給；把它單獨放在 /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare.token，擁有者 root、權限 600：其他人讀得到的檔案腳本會拒絕使用，token 也絕不會寫到任何地方。account_id（或 zone_ids）在控制台的概覽頁。manager 需要能以 HTTPS 連到 api.cloudflare.com（透過代理時在設定檔加 proxy=），腳本以 /usr/bin/python3 執行：Wazuh 內附的 Python 沒有 CA 憑證。把管理者、監控與合作夥伴的位址寫進 /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare-allow.txt。想要溫和一點的回應，可以把 mode 設為 managed_challenge 而不是 block。
setup.code:
install -o root -g wazuh -m 0750 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-cloudflare-block /var/ossec/active-response/bin/jt-cloudflare-block
install -o root -g root -m 0600 /dev/null /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare.token   # then write the token into it
printf 'scope=account\naccount_id=<32 hex digits>\nmode=block\n' > /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare-block.conf
touch /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare-allow.txt
/var/ossec/active-response/bin/jt-cloudflare-block --check
setup.verify: --check prints the scope and that the token can read its access rules. After a response blocks, --list shows the rule and the manager shows rule 657; Cloudflare's dashboard lists it under Security > WAF > Tools with the note jt-wazuh-mgr active response.
setup.verify_zh: --check 會顯示範圍，以及 token 能讀取存取規則。回應封鎖之後，--list 會列出規則，manager 上出現規則 657；Cloudflare 控制台的 Security > WAF > Tools 會列出備註為 jt-wazuh-mgr active response 的規則。

scripts.name: jt-cloudflare-block
scripts.description: Cloudflare active response; not scheduled: copied to active-response/bin on each manager node when the response is used

active_response.title: Deny, in nginx, an address that was served a sensitive file or an exploit endpoint
active_response.title_zh: 在 nginx 封鎖取得了敏感檔案或漏洞端點內容的位址
active_response.body: Runs jt-nginx-deny on the agent that logged the request. The client address, as nginx restored it with realip (so this works for sites behind Cloudflare or another proxy, where a firewall would only see the proxy), is added to the deny list nginx includes at http level; nginx -t checks the result before nginx reloads, and the previous list is put back if it fails. Every site of that nginx then answers the address with 403, until Wazuh removes the entry when the timeout ends (a day by default). Needs the jt-nginx-deny command on every manager node, and on each reverse proxy the script in /var/ossec/active-response/bin and the nginx snippet (see the setup steps); on the other agents of the web group the response logs "not set up" and changes nothing. It never blocks private, loopback, carrier NAT, documentation or Cloudflare addresses, nor anything in /etc/nginx/jt-ar-allow.txt, and the manager never sends it an address in <global><white_list>. Risk: 133012 also fires when a site publishes such a file on purpose (a .sql or .zip download, a public key), and its visitors are then blocked for a day: exclude those paths with a site rule first. The address is the first field of the access log, which nginx writes, so a request cannot choose it, unless a site trusts X-Forwarded-For or CF-Connecting-IP from anyone (set_real_ip_from 0.0.0.0/0): then any request can name an address and have it blocked. set_real_ip_from must list only Cloudflare's and your own proxies' ranges.
active_response.body_zh: 在記錄這筆請求的 agent 上執行 jt-nginx-deny。nginx 經 realip 還原的用戶端位址（所以在 Cloudflare 或其他代理後面的網站也有效，防火牆在那裡只看得到代理）會加入 nginx 在 http 層引入的封鎖清單；重新載入前先以 nginx -t 檢查，失敗就放回原本的清單。之後該 nginx 上的每個網站都對這個位址回應 403，直到逾時（預設一天）由 Wazuh 移除。需要在每個 manager 節點定義 jt-nginx-deny 指令，並在每台反向代理放好 /var/ossec/active-response/bin 裡的腳本與 nginx 設定片段（見部署步驟）；web 群組裡其他 agent 只會記錄「not set up」，什麼都不改。它絕不封鎖私有、迴環、電信業者 NAT、文件用途或 Cloudflare 的位址，也不封鎖 /etc/nginx/jt-ar-allow.txt 裡的位址；<global><white_list> 裡的位址 manager 根本不會送出。風險：網站刻意公開這類檔案時（.sql 或 .zip 下載、公開金鑰）133012 也會觸發，下載的訪客就會被封鎖一天：請先以站台規則排除那些路徑。位址取自存取記錄的第一個欄位，由 nginx 寫入，請求本身無法指定；除非某個網站信任任何來源送的 X-Forwarded-For 或 CF-Connecting-IP（set_real_ip_from 0.0.0.0/0），那樣任何請求都能指定一個位址讓它被封鎖。set_real_ip_from 只能列 Cloudflare 與自家代理的位址範圍。

active_response.title: Deny, in nginx, an address that probed six or more sensitive files or exploit endpoints in five minutes
active_response.title_zh: 在 nginx 封鎖五分鐘內探測六個以上敏感檔案或漏洞端點的位址
active_response.body: Runs jt-nginx-deny on the agent that logged the request. The client address, as nginx restored it with realip (so this works for sites behind Cloudflare or another proxy, where a firewall would only see the proxy), is added to the deny list nginx includes at http level; nginx -t checks the result before nginx reloads, and the previous list is put back if it fails. Every site of that nginx then answers the address with 403, until Wazuh removes the entry when the timeout ends (a day by default). Needs the jt-nginx-deny command on every manager node, and on each reverse proxy the script in /var/ossec/active-response/bin and the nginx snippet (see the setup steps); on the other agents of the web group the response logs "not set up" and changes nothing. It never blocks private, loopback, carrier NAT, documentation or Cloudflare addresses, nor anything in /etc/nginx/jt-ar-allow.txt, and the manager never sends it an address in <global><white_list>. Risk: A shared address (a mobile carrier's NAT, a company proxy, a VPN exit, Cloudflare WARP or iCloud Private Relay) blocks everyone behind it for the timeout. Put administrator, monitoring and backup addresses, and any scanner or uptime service you run or subscribe to, in the allowlist and in <global><white_list> first. The address is the first field of the access log, which nginx writes, so a request cannot choose it, unless a site trusts X-Forwarded-For or CF-Connecting-IP from anyone (set_real_ip_from 0.0.0.0/0): then any request can name an address and have it blocked. set_real_ip_from must list only Cloudflare's and your own proxies' ranges.
active_response.body_zh: 在記錄這筆請求的 agent 上執行 jt-nginx-deny。nginx 經 realip 還原的用戶端位址（所以在 Cloudflare 或其他代理後面的網站也有效，防火牆在那裡只看得到代理）會加入 nginx 在 http 層引入的封鎖清單；重新載入前先以 nginx -t 檢查，失敗就放回原本的清單。之後該 nginx 上的每個網站都對這個位址回應 403，直到逾時（預設一天）由 Wazuh 移除。需要在每個 manager 節點定義 jt-nginx-deny 指令，並在每台反向代理放好 /var/ossec/active-response/bin 裡的腳本與 nginx 設定片段（見部署步驟）；web 群組裡其他 agent 只會記錄「not set up」，什麼都不改。它絕不封鎖私有、迴環、電信業者 NAT、文件用途或 Cloudflare 的位址，也不封鎖 /etc/nginx/jt-ar-allow.txt 裡的位址；<global><white_list> 裡的位址 manager 根本不會送出。風險：共用位址（行動業者的 NAT、公司的代理、VPN 出口、Cloudflare WARP 或 iCloud 私密轉送）會讓其後的所有人在逾時前都被封鎖。請先把管理者、監控與備份主機的位址，以及你自己執行或訂閱的掃描、運作監測服務，加入允許清單與 <global><white_list>。位址取自存取記錄的第一個欄位，由 nginx 寫入，請求本身無法指定；除非某個網站信任任何來源送的 X-Forwarded-For 或 CF-Connecting-IP（set_real_ip_from 0.0.0.0/0），那樣任何請求都能指定一個位址讓它被封鎖。set_real_ip_from 只能列 Cloudflare 與自家代理的位址範圍。

active_response.title: Deny, in nginx, a vulnerability scanner that sent 20 or more requests in five minutes
active_response.title_zh: 在 nginx 封鎖五分鐘內送出 20 次以上請求的弱點掃描工具
active_response.body: Runs jt-nginx-deny on the agent that logged the request. The client address, as nginx restored it with realip (so this works for sites behind Cloudflare or another proxy, where a firewall would only see the proxy), is added to the deny list nginx includes at http level; nginx -t checks the result before nginx reloads, and the previous list is put back if it fails. Every site of that nginx then answers the address with 403, until Wazuh removes the entry when the timeout ends (a day by default). It never blocks private, loopback, carrier NAT, documentation or Cloudflare addresses, nor anything in /etc/nginx/jt-ar-allow.txt, and the manager never sends it an address in <global><white_list>. Risk: the rule matches the scanner's user agent, which the sender chooses: a careful attacker changes it and is not blocked, while a scan you commission yourself is, so allowlist your own scanners. A shared address (a mobile carrier's NAT, a company proxy, a VPN exit, Cloudflare WARP or iCloud Private Relay) blocks everyone behind it for the timeout. active_response.title: Block, at Cloudflare, an address that was served a sensitive file or exploit endpoint, or probed or scanned the sites
active_response.title_zh: 在 Cloudflare 封鎖取得了敏感檔案或漏洞端點內容、或探測與掃描網站的位址
active_response.body: Runs jt-cloudflare-block on the manager node that raised the alert: it creates a Cloudflare IP Access Rule (block, or a challenge if mode says so) for the address, for the whole account or for the zones listed in /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare-block.conf, and deletes it when the timeout ends (a day by default). It only ever deletes rules it made itself (their note starts with "jt-wazuh-mgr active response"); a rule someone else made for the same address is left alone. Use it for sites proxied by Cloudflare, whose visitors never reach nginx directly; it can run together with the nginx responses. Needs the jt-cloudflare-block command and script on every manager node, an API token in /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare.token (root, mode 600, never logged) and outbound HTTPS from the managers to api.cloudflare.com (see the setup steps). It refuses the same addresses as the nginx responses; the allowlist on the managers is /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare-allow.txt. A failed call is rule 133050 (level 10), not a silent miss. Risk: an account-level rule blocks the address on every zone of the account, including sites the alert had nothing to do with. A shared address (a mobile carrier's NAT, a company proxy, a VPN exit, Cloudflare WARP or iCloud Private Relay) blocks everyone behind it for the timeout. Put administrator, monitoring and backup addresses, and any scanner or uptime service you run or subscribe to, in the allowlist and in <global><white_list> first.
active_response.body_zh: 在產生告警的 manager 節點上執行 jt-cloudflare-block：為該位址建立一條 Cloudflare IP Access Rule（封鎖，或依 mode 設定改為挑戰），範圍是整個帳戶或 /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare-block.conf 列出的 zone，逾時（預設一天）後再刪除。它只刪除自己建立的規則（備註以「jt-wazuh-mgr active response」開頭）；別人為同一位址建的規則不會動。用在經 Cloudflare 代理的網站，那些訪客從不直接連到 nginx；可以和 nginx 的回應同時啟用。需要在每個 manager 節點定義 jt-cloudflare-block 指令並放好腳本、/var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare.token 裡的 API token（root、權限 600、絕不寫進記錄），以及 manager 能以 HTTPS 連到 api.cloudflare.com（見部署步驟）。拒絕封鎖的位址與 nginx 的回應相同；manager 上的允許清單是 /var/ossec/etc/jt-cloudflare-allow.txt。呼叫失敗是規則 133050（level 10），不會無聲漏掉。風險：帳戶層級的規則會在帳戶內每個 zone 封鎖該位址，包括與這次告警無關的網站。共用位址（行動業者的 NAT、公司的代理、VPN 出口、Cloudflare WARP 或 iCloud 私密轉送）會讓其後的所有人在逾時前都被封鎖。請先把管理者、監控與備份主機的位址，以及你自己執行或訂閱的掃描、運作監測服務，加入允許清單與 <global><white_list>。
